scenario.name: Crypt of Ghouls
scenario.description: Tier 2 5e 2024 (SRD 5.2) undead gauntlet: three Level 5 adventurers (Champion Fighter, Evoker Wizard, Life Cleric) face four Ghouls, two Ghasts, a Mummy, and a Skeleton archer, testing AoE Fireball placement, Paralysis threat management, 0-HP revival via Healing Word, Bless concentration, Extra Attack, and Weapon Masteries.

actions.rationale: Close 10 ft to (0,15) so I am adjacent to the ghast/ghoul cluster at (5,20) and next to downed Lyra. No enemy reach is left, so this provokes nothing, and I keep 20 ft of movement plus my action for Extra Attack.
actions.table_talk: Dorian, Lyra's down and paralyzed. Healing Word her! I'm moving in to pull the ghasts off her.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance moves 10 ft to (0, 15).

actions.rationale: Ghast-1 hasn't acted yet and is next to the downed, paralyzed Lyra, so its hits on her will be auto-crits. A longsword hit applies Sap mastery, giving it Disadvantage on its next attack and protecting her. I'll keep using Extra Attack on the same target.
actions.table_talk: Sapping the ghast so it can't finish Lyra. Dorian, get her up with Healing Word!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Crypt Ghast with Longsword (26 vs AC 13) for 6 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Crypt Ghast Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: Ghast A is already Sapped. Using my Extra Attack to Sap Ghast B, the hardest-hitting enemy next to Lyra, gives its next attack Disadvantage. That lowers the chance of auto-crits on our unconscious wizard.
actions.table_talk: Both ghasts are sapped now. Dorian, Healing Word on Lyra ASAP. Each hit on her is a crit while she's down!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Crypt Ghast B with Longsword (18 vs AC 13) for 10 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Crypt Ghast B Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: Both attacks are spent and no bonus actions are listed as available. Moving would provoke Opportunity Attacks from three adjacent enemies and leave Lyra exposed. Better to hold position next to her with my reaction ready for an Opportunity Attack.
actions.table_talk: Both ghasts are sapped and I'm holding the line by Lyra. Dorian, Healing Word her now! She's taking auto-crits while she's down.

actions.rationale: Both allies are down and I have no way to heal them. The best play is to focus the already-damaged Ghast and use Sap so its next attack has disadvantage. That lowers the chance of auto-crits on downed Dorian and Lyra while I work to reduce enemy numbers.
actions.table_talk: Hang on, both of you. I'm sapping the ghasts so they can't finish you off. Stay with me!
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Crypt Ghast with Longsword (24 vs AC 13) for 9 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Crypt Ghast Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: Ghast-1 is already sapped, so I'm using my last attack on Ghast B to apply Sap. Its next attack gets Disadvantage, which lowers the chance of auto-crits on my downed allies or a paralyzing hit on me.
actions.table_talk: Both ghasts will be sapped again. Hold on, Lyra and Dorian. I'm keeping their claws off you.
narrative_hooks: Aldric Vance hits Crypt Ghast B with Longsword (21 vs AC 13) for 5 slashing damage.
Sap mastery gives Crypt Ghast B Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

actions.rationale: I've used my action and Extra Attack: both ghasts are sapped. No bonus actions are available. Moving would provoke opportunity attacks from four adjacent enemies and leave the downed allies uncovered, so I'm holding position.
actions.table_talk: Both ghasts have Disadvantage on their next swings. I'm staying put between them and you two. Hang in there!
